title: "UC Berkeley Library Dataverse Documentation"

Welcome to the UC Berkeley Library Dataverse documentation website. Here you can find information on how to get started with Dataverse, including guides for depositing and downloading datasets.

## Research Data Support at UC Berkeley

UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is managed and maintained by the Library’s [Data \+ Digital Scholarship Services](https://www.lib.berkeley.edu/research/data-services) and Library IT.

For additional research data support at UC Berkeley, contact our [Research Data Management Program](https://researchdata.berkeley.edu/). To find GIS data, visit the Library's [GeoData Portal](https://geodata.lib.berkeley.edu/).
